title: Accra Fish Fritters
description: Accra Fish Fritters is a dish from Saint Lucia featuring salt cod, all-purpose flour, chicken egg, green onion. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Soak salt cod in cold water in the refrigerator for about 24 hours, changing the water several times. Drain before simmering; never soak salted fish at room temperature.
Gently cook the prepared contents in the simmering liquid from earlier steps until fully cooked and safe to eat.
Flake the thoroughly cooked, desalted cod with a fork; remove every bone and keep the fish ready for the mixture.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 15 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
